observation_scope: Past independent available-source observations; present public validation checks included factual linkage only.

observations.role: Grand Lake main-basin association and White Lake generalized identity
observations.observation: The readable Grand Lake label is northwest of the separate White Lake heart-shaped water. Complete target areas are shown. Northern/eastern connections and the southeast projection of the Grand target are not individually name-assigned. Repeated panels are one publication.

observations.role: Mermentau basin and coastal hydrologic context
observations.observation: The plan describes controlled basin drainage and runoff impoundment with a regional coastal-marsh gradient. The basin and protected-feature maps give context without readable target name partitions or current salinity measurements.

observations.role: Documented French body usage and basin context
observations.observation: The basin overview explicitly uses lac Témiscamingue for a receiving waterbody. The linked full report was not acquired; the overview does not establish complete geometry or formal naming equivalence.

observations.role: Documented English body usage, reservoir table and contextual basin schematic
observations.observation: The body uses Lake Timiskaming and the table links Timiskaming to reservoir 4. The small whole-basin map provides regional placement but does not resolve all target arms, marker-obscured water or lake/downstream endpoint. Its URL directory is not a publication date.

included_evidence_limit: Included files contain factual observations, bibliography and selected public-domain geometry. Original publications and inspection materials are omitted. Public validation checks only included facts and coordinates; it cannot reproduce omitted visual source judgments or complete the pending Timiskaming assessment.
